Based on the retrieved excerpts, the clause that requires your organization to establish processes for consulting workers and getting them to participate in the OH&S management system is **clause 5.4**.

This clause explicitly states that "The organization must establish, implement and maintain processes for consultation and participation of workers at all levels and functions — and of workers' representatives where they exist — in the development, planning, implementation, performance evaluation and improvement actions of the OH&S system." It also specifically requires removing barriers such as "language, literacy or fear of reprisal" and giving "special emphasis to the involvement of non-managerial workers" — which would include your warehouse crew.

This goes well beyond a suggestion box approach, as it requires formal processes for worker involvement across the full lifecycle of the OH&S system: development, planning, implementation, performance evaluation, and improvement actions.
